Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s instruction to open and cite authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia page content, ASCAP/BMI, Discogs, AllMusic) to confirm the songwriter for Norah Jones’s “Turn Me On.” Instead, it repeatedly returned the same search results page and surfaced a conflicting, unreliable snippet (Genius claiming Lee Alexander) without resolving the discrepancy. This behavior initiated a loop of redundant searches and inadequate verification, which could have led to an incorrect conclusion and stalled progress despite sufficient evidence pointing to John D. Loudermilk.
